snippet.title: Cricket 26 Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Cricket 26 – The Ultimate Showdown

Key Features

MANAGEMENT CAREER: Every decision matters! - Take command of your favourite team in the all-new Management Career Mode.
•Select lineups and batting orders
•Set tactics and match strategies
•Develop rising talent and manage injuries
•Lead your squad to international glory

THE ASHES: Step into the Ashes. Experience every moment! - Cricket’s biggest rivalry is back, bigger than ever, with an expanded Ashes Mode.
•Experience iconic highlights and press conferences
•Take control of full Australian and English squads
•Connect with the tour through team nets sessions

PRO TEAM: Collect. Assemble. Dominate! - Build your ultimate Pro Team squad and test your team in the new Centurion multiplayer mode.
•Open weekly card packs or target players via the Auction House
•Complete single and multiplayer weekly challenges
•Upgrade and strategize your team for long-term fun

ACADEMY: Create. Share. Play! - Unleash your creativity with the Academy.
•Create and share stadiums, players, and full teams
•Play and download content from the Cricket 26 community

GAMEPLAY: Control every ball. Master every match! - Step up to a whole new level of control with enhanced batting mechanics.
•Place push shots into gaps for quick singles
•Control fielder aggressiveness for smarter defensive play
•Strategically limit run rates or conserve energy during Tests
